items.issue: PRD must-have is self-contradictory: it names the signature waitFor(predicate, { timeout = 3000, interval = 25 }) while the same sentence requires the helper to await flush(). flush is a per-render closure, so a module-level helper cannot reach it unless it is passed in.
items.reason: Resolved by the simplest safe assumption: the flush clause wins, since a poller that never flushes fails the PRDs stated purpose, while one extra optional option breaks nothing. Both documented defaults survive unchanged. The PRD text should be corrected to name the flush option, rather than the code changed back.
items.resolution: post-completion note on done PRD 00033 names the { timeout, interval, flush } option; code unchanged
